description: This file contains functions to create tar archive members with specific properties, including padding and header construction, used for packaging or backup purposes in a shell environment.

methods.name: tar_print_member
methods.description: Creates a tar archive member header with specified name and content, including padding and metadata such as mode, uid, gid, and mtime.

methods.name: tar_print_trailer
methods.description: Outputs padding to denote the end of a tar archive.

methods.name: __tar_print_padding
methods.description: Outputs zero bytes for padding purposes in tar archive construction.
